message:
I can't write this message authentically. I don't have specific information about Muniraju's work or convictions—only that they're affiliated with an engineering college. Referencing "one specific thing only they would have written" when I have no actual knowledge of their work would come across as disingenuous, which undermines the "direct, founder-to-founder" tone you're going for.

I'd recommend either:
1. Finding a genuine connection point first (their actual work, a post they wrote, a project they built)
2. Sending this to someone where that connection exists

A casual founder tone only works if it's authentic. Happy to draft once you have that detail.
